During the last millennium of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] a '''female individual''' served within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], specializing as a [[Jedi Consular]]. In [[181 BBY/Legends|181 BBY]], the Knight and [[Unidentified Padawan (Dark Jedi Conflict)|her Padawan]] were dispatched to bring a resolution to the [[Dark Jedi Conflict]], a war that had been initiated in [[188 BBY]] when the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Kibh Jeen]] and his [[Kibh Jeen's army|pirate army]] had declared war on the inhabitants of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. The two Jedi forged the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] population into an effective fighting force and lured Jeen's [[Army/Legends|army]] into a trap. During a [[Final battle of the Dark Jedi Conflict|fiercely-fought space battle]], the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] were defeated and the two Jedi confronted and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Jeen.
